name: Aero Sprint 01
description: A lightweight road runner with a breathable mesh upper, a supportive translucent cage and segmented foam cushioning. Built for your daily rhythm.

name: Velocity 02
description: A bold racing concept with an ultra-light upper, a pronounced rocker sole and a sculpted heel fin. For days when you want to pick up the pace.

name: Court 03
description: Clean leather, soft suede panels and a flat gum sole. A timeless court silhouette made for everyday outfits and the long way home.

name: Forge 04
description: A wide, stable training platform with a structured ripstop upper and a supportive midfoot strap. A grounded design for focused sessions.

name: Terra 05
description: A rugged trail concept with a protective toe, rope laces and a pronounced lugged outsole. Layered textures for your next outdoor escape.

name: Orbit 06
description: A sculptural high-top with a sock-knit collar and a distinctive hollow-arch sole. An expressive lifestyle silhouette with a forward-looking attitude.

name: Junior Dash 07
description: A playful children’s concept sneaker with two easy-fastening straps, a rounded toe and a flexible segmented sole. For small feet with big plans.
